prompt: The Country field at checkout is free text and people mistype it. The 27 countries are Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain and Sweden. Keep the label "Country". Write it yourself in React, no new packages. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
